title: PLAYER 2 SEES A BURNING DOWNED PILLAGER GET UP EARLY
why: The body snapshot used one flag bit (8388608) for two things: burning and getting up. When a downed pillager was hit by a fire round, player 2's window read the burn as the get-up: it showed the get-up bar and played the pick sound up to 3 s early (misleading his finisher window), then played no sound at the real get-up, and a man getting up who had stopped burning was drawn on fire. Proven in headless Chromium by downing a pillager, hitting him with elemHit fire, and feeding the host snapshot row through netEntsApply to a linked copy each frame. Now the row carries a ninth number with burning and getting up apart, and the linked window reads that; the old bit stays set as before for older readers.
now: In co-op, player 2 no longer sees a burning downed pillager start to get up early, and hears the get-up when it really happens.
